jobs.title: F&B Service Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Operations & Standards

- Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices.

- Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels.

- Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards.

- Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence.

Guest Experience & Quality Assurance

- Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements.

- Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering.

- Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs.

Training & Leadership Development

- Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy.

- Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning.

Human Resources & Leadership Oversight

- Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel.

- Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet.

- Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership.

- Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required.

Financial Oversight

- Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet.

- Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems.

- Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards.

- Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Results-driven, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative.

- Capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.title: Shore Excursions Product Development Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

jobs.title: Destinations Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

The Destination Experience Manager is fully responsible for the performance, development, and operational excellence of assigned regions.
This role requires strong cruise shore excursion experience, deep knowledge of ports and destination logistics, and a solid understanding of onboard operations. The Manager oversees the full lifecycle of destination experiences — from sourcing and contracting to onboard delivery and financial performance.

Your Impact

Destination & Product Management
•    Develop and manage destination experiences across assigned regions
•    Scout and contract TOs/DMCs through structured bidding and negotiation
•    Ensure experiences are operationally feasible and aligned with luxury brand standards
•    Manage pricing, ROI, and capacity planning
•    Oversee content coordination with Marketing and system loading (Seaware, Otalio, etc.)

Onboard & Operational Support
•    Ensure products reflect onboard realities (timings, guest demographics, mobility considerations)
•    Train and support onboard Destination teams
•    Assist with escalations, refunds, and service recovery when required
•    Monitor guest feedback and implement corrective actions

Financial & Performance Management
•    Own budgeting and revenue performance for assigned regions
•    Monitor margins, refund trends, and voyage-level contribution
•    Identify underperforming ports and optimize offerings accordingly
•    Partner with Finance and Analytics on reporting and dashboards

Your Journey so far

- 7–10+ years in cruise shore excursions, destination management, or luxury travel

- Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or equivalent experience preferred.

Your Essentials

- Strong onboard cruise experience and operational understanding

- Deep knowledge of ports and destination infrastructure

- Knowledge of Alaska, Caribbean, South America, or Asia regions is a strong advantage

- Proven negotiation and financial management skills

- Strong analytical and communication abilities

- Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset

- Valid Swiss work permit or eligibility to work in Switzerland / US permit for Miami position

At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony.
We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea.
Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

jobs.description:
Where passion meets opportunity

Discover your journey into the extraordinary.

Your Purpose

Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers.An exciting opportunity exists for a talented Digital Professional to join our newly created luxury travel brand Explora Journeys. This role is based in the office in Geneva.The Digital Platforms Manager will lead the strategy, development and deployment of our travel App.

Your Impact

The Digital platforms Manager will:

- Lead the strategy of the EJ guest Area including My Explora and our travel App

- Design and lead the development of the new App

- Define and maintain the Guest Area strategy and roadmap aligned with business goals.

- Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices for platform management.

- Identify opportunities for platforms innovation, optimization, and new capabilities.

- Document product features and create user stories

- Lead the creation and maintenance of platforms roadmap

- Translate complex technical requirements into actionable product specifications

- Communicate with cross-functional teams, including developers, designers, and business stakeholders

- Support the testing and release processes for new product updates

- Spot, report and follow the resolution & correction of bugs

- Monitor product performance metrics and making data-driven decisions

- Define KPIs and dashboards to track platform success.

Your Journey so far

- You have minimum of 8/10 years’ experience in a similar Role preferably in the Luxury or Luxury Hospitality/Travel Industry

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Digital Marketing, or related field.

- Experience managing web platforms, mobile apps, or enterprise digital ecosystems.

Your Essentials

- You set yourself apart through your personal accountability to deliver with excellence

- You are structured, well organized and know how to navigate in a matrix organisation

- Strong knowledge on the Digital projects lifecycle, particularly on complex or highly technical products

- You are a fast learner and tech savvy

- Knowledge in Adobe Experience Manager is a plus

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets.
The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance.
Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter.

Your Impact

1. Operational Leadership Across the Asset Lifecycle
Own end-to-end operational responsibility from pre-opening through live operations.
Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards.
Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations.

2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction)
Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones.
In coordination with Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.), define Procurements needs and implement it. FFE/OWS.
Influence design decisions to ensure operational efficiency, safety and maintainability.
Establish operating structures, SOPs and governance well ahead of opening.
Manage handovers from construction to operations, including phased turnovers.
For each project, identify personnel need and -in conjunction with HR- ensure the operational ability of new assets. Establish Training Programs for operational readiness.

3. Post-Opening Operations Management
Direct daily operations across all departments (hospitality, F&B, retail, attractions, marine, security, maintenance, guest services).
Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards.
Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset.

4. Workforce, Training & Culture
Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce.
Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening.
Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture.

5. Financial & Commercial Performance
Own operational P&L, cost controls and productivity metrics.
Manage operating budgets, capex planning and lifecycle reserves.
Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable).

6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management
Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards.
Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning.
Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections.

Your Journey so far

- 15+ years senior operations leadership in hospitality, cruise destinations, resorts, ports, theme parks or large hospitality assets.

- Demonstrated ownership of both pre-opening and long-term operations.

- Strong background working alongside development, construction and technical services teams.

- Experience in Caribbean or island environments strongly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Operational readiness & lifecycle operations

- Large-scale workforce leadership

- Financial & P&L accountability

- Asset lifecycle & maintenance management

- Multi-operator and concession management

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Define the long-term operating vision, KPIs and service standards. Ensure continuity of design, culture and systems from project phase into steady-state operations. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Lead the operational readiness program aligned with construction milestones. Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the asset. 4. Workforce, Training & Culture Build, lead and retain a high-performing, multi-national workforce. titleByLocale.it: Responsabile delle Slot e delle Operazioni Tecniche del Casinò
titleByLocale.en: Casino Slots and Technical Operations Manager
titleByLocale.de: Casino Slots and Technical Operations Manager
titleByLocale.fr: Casino Slots and Technical Operations Manager

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead Onboard Casino Technical teams, ensuring smooth operations, maintaining high standards of service, and maximising revenue generation. As a Casino Slot and Technical Operations Manager, you will be responsible for monitoring slot machine performance, analysing gaming data, and implementing strategies to enhance player satisfaction and profitability. Your role will involve regular inspections and maintenance scheduling to ensure all slot machines are functioning correctly and efficiently. You will also be responsible for managing inventory, ordering new equipment, and coordinating installations and upgrades. You will be expected to stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, proactively adapting operations to maintain compliance and competitive advantage.

Your Impact

• Oversee all technical projects and actively participate in their implementation. Maintain an excellent line of communication with the shore and ship technical department to ensure all casino projects are deployed according to schedule and comply to the company’s technical and safety standards.
• Assist with budgeting, forecasting and revenue analysis.
• Manage budgets, control costs, and optimise resource allocation.
• Support and guide onboard Casino management team on each vessel through constant communication and regular ship operational visits. Discuss any areas of concern specific to the Operation and brand specific product, and similarly address points of commendation.
• Provide accurate and objective assessment of onboard Casino operations and personnel.
• Revenue analysis, identifying trends with the ability to create structured solutions to increase or enhance revenue streams. Explore new ways of increasing existing revenue and /or improving current working practices, whilst at the same time maintaining a high technical and security standard onboard our ships.
• Isolate areas falling below standard with members of the Casino Shipboard management team.
• Training of all management teams in Slot Revenue, Security and Surveillance.
• Confirm that security measures meet minimum requirements.
• Provide troubleshooting support and advice via email to shipboard technical teams.
• Assess, evaluate and review data for organizing projects and/or providing directions on activities, tasks or processes in accordance with company guidelines.

Your Journey so far

• Minimum 5 years of experience in casino slot operations management.
• Previous experience working on a cruise ship is mandatory.

Your Essentials

• Strong knowledge of gaming regulations and compliance requirements.
• Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficiency in analysing gaming data and financial reports.
• Ability to manage budgets, control costs, and optimize resources.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire principal de projet - Investissements en infrastructure (Caraïbes)

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; - Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience in a matrixed, multinational environment, including at least 5 -7 years in a Senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role; - Proven HR experience within the hospitality, cruise, travel or customer-centric industry, with a strong understanding of service culture; - Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders in a corporate or headquarters environment; - Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver HR initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines; - Solid exposure to performance management, talent processes, employee relations, and organisational support; - Experience working with global HR policies, frameworks, and HR systems (HRIS); - Knowledge of Swiss Labour Law is an advantage; - Fluent in English; French is an advantage. jobs.title: Multimedia and AV Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams.

Your Impact

- Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems.

- Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences.

- Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration.

- Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives.

- Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms.

- Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence.

- Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations.

- Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines.

- Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies.

- Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership.

- Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms.

Your Journey so far

- Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must.

- Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry.

- Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The SPA Product Manager is responsible for the strategic development, management, and optimization of spa products, treatments, and retail offerings. This role ensures that all spa products align with brand positioning, guest expectations, and commercial objectives, while driving revenue, innovation, and operational excellence across the spa portfolio.

Your Impact

- Define and execute the spa product strategy, including treatments, retail products, and wellness concepts, in line with brand standards and business goals

- Manage the full product lifecycle, from concept development and supplier selection to launch, performance  monitoring, and optimization

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Spa Operations, Marketing, Training, Procurement, Finance) to ensure seamless product implementation

- Lead supplier relationships, and performance reviews.

- Analyze product performance through KPIs, guest feedback, and financial results, and implement datadriven improvements

- Ensure all products comply with regulatory, safety, and brand standards across all locations.

- Support the development of pricing strategies, promotions, and revenue-driving initiatives.

- Work closely with Training teams to ensure therapists and staff are fully trained on products and treatments.

- Monitor market trends, and innovations within the spa and wellness industry to maintain a competitive offering.

- Support new openings, refurbishments, and special projects related to spa product development.

Your Journey so far

- Strong commercial and analytical mindset with proven experience in product performance management

- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

- Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution

- Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

- High attention to detail with a focus on quality and guest experience

- Proven experience in spa, wellness, beauty, or hospitality product management

- Strong understanding of spa operations, treatments, and retail environments

- Experience working with premium or luxury brands preferre

Your Essentials

- 10-15 years of experience in SPA and Wellness including Medispa treatments , retail products, and wellness concepts,

- Proven experience in managining the full product lifecycle, from concept development and supplier selection, legal requirements, launch, performance monitoring, and optimization.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills especially in guiding large teams and influencing stakeholders.

- Fluency in English is mandatory any other language is a plus.

- Strong leadership skills to oversee SPA operations across multiple locations.

- Experience with project management financial analysis and revenue management in the wellness or hospitality industry.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il tuo scopo

SPA Product Manager è responsabile dello sviluppo strategico, della gestione e dell'ottimizzazione dei prodotti spa, dei trattamenti e delle offerte di vendita al dettaglio. Questo ruolo garantisce che tutti i prodotti spa si allineano con il posizionamento del marchio, le aspettative degli ospiti e gli obiettivi commerciali, mentre guidano i ricavi, l'innovazione e l'eccellenza operativa in tutto il portafoglio spa.

Il tuo impatto

- Definire ed eseguire la strategia del prodotto spa, compresi i trattamenti, i prodotti di vendita al dettaglio e i concetti di benessere, in linea con gli standard del marchio e gli obiettivi aziendali

- Gestire il ciclo di vita completo del prodotto, dallo sviluppo del concetto e dalla selezione dei fornitori al lancio, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e ottimizzazione

- Collaborare con gli stakeholder interni (Operazioni Spagna, Marketing, Formazione, Procurement, Finanza) per garantire l'implementazione dei prodotti senza soluzione di continuità

- Lead rapporti dei fornitori e recensioni sulle prestazioni.

- Analizzare le prestazioni del prodotto attraverso KPI, feedback degli ospiti e risultati finanziari, e implementare miglioramenti datadriven

- Assicurarsi che tutti i prodotti siano conformi alle normative, alla sicurezza e agli standard di marca in tutte le sedi.

- Sostenere lo sviluppo di strategie di prezzi, promozioni e iniziative di gestione dei ricavi.

- Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di formazione per garantire che i terapeuti e il personale siano pienamente formati su prodotti e trattamenti.

- Monitorare le tendenze del mercato e le innovazioni all'interno del settore spa e benessere per mantenere un'offerta competitiva.

- Sostenere nuove aperture, ristrutturazioni e progetti speciali relativi allo sviluppo di prodotti spa.

Il tuo viaggio finora

- Forte mentalità commerciale e analitica con comprovata esperienza nella gestione delle prestazioni del prodotto

- Eccellente capacità di gestione e comunicazione degli stakeholder

- Capacità di gestire più progetti contemporaneamente in un ambiente di velocità

- pensiero strategico combinato con l'esecuzione manuale

- Forte capacità di negoziazione e gestione dei fornitori

- Alta attenzione ai dettagli con un focus sulla qualità e l'esperienza degli ospiti

- Esperienza comprovata in spa, benessere, bellezza o gestione del prodotto dell'ospitalità

- Forte comprensione delle operazioni di spa, dei trattamenti e degli ambienti di vendita al dettaglio

- Esperienza di lavoro con marchi premium o di lusso preferisconore

I tuoi essenziali

- 10-15 anni di esperienza in SPA e Wellness tra cui trattamenti Medispa, prodotti di vendita al dettaglio e concetti di benessere,

- Esperienza comprovata nell'agitare il ciclo di vita completo del prodotto, dalla selezione di concetti e fornitori, requisiti legali, lancio, monitoraggio delle prestazioni e ottimizzazione.

- Ottima capacità di comunicazione e leadership, soprattutto nel guidare grandi team e influenzare gli stakeholder.

- La fluenza in inglese è obbligatoria qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus.

- Forte capacità di leadership per supervisionare le operazioni SPA in più posizioni.

- Esperienza con la gestione del progetto analisi finanziaria e gestione dei ricavi nel settore del benessere o dell'ospitalità.

- Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con dipartimenti come Marketing Guest Services e Revenue Management per creare un'esperienza di benessere coesa per gli ospiti.

- Nazionalità svizzera o diritto di lavoro in Svizzera.

Il nostro impegno

Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta.

Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.de:
Ihr Ziel

Der SPA Product Manager ist verantwortlich für die strategische Entwicklung, Verwaltung und Optimierung von Spa-Produkten, Behandlungen und Einzelhandelsangeboten. Diese Rolle sorgt dafür, dass alle Spa-Produkte mit Markenpositionierung, Gasterwartungen und kommerziellen Zielen übereinstimmen und Umsatz, Innovation und operative Exzellenz im gesamten Spa-Portfolio vorantreiben.

Ihre Auswirkungen

- Definieren und führen Sie die Spa-Produktstrategie, einschließlich Behandlungen, Retail-Produkte und Wellness-Konzepte, im Einklang mit Markenstandards und Geschäftszielen

- Verwalten Sie den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der Konzeptentwicklung und Lieferantenauswahl bis zum Start, Leistungsüberwachung und Optimierung

- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern (Spa Operations, Marketing, Training, Beschaffung, Finanzen), um eine nahtlose Produktumsetzung zu gewährleisten

- Führen Sie Lieferantenbeziehungen und Leistungsbewertungen.

- Analyse der Produktleistung durch Kennzahlen, Gäste-Feedback und Finanzergebnisse und Implementierung datengetriebener Verbesserungen

- Stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Produkte den regulatorischen, Sicherheits- und Markenstandards an allen Standorten entsprechen.

- Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung von Preisstrategien, Förderungen und geldtreibenden Initiativen.

- Arbeiten Sie eng mit Trainingsteams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Therapeuten und Mitarbeiter vollständig auf Produkte und Behandlungen trainiert werden.

- Überwachen Sie Markttrends und Innovationen in der Wellness- und Wellnessbranche, um ein wettbewerbsfähiges Angebot zu erhalten.

- Unterstützung neuer Öffnungen, Sanierungen und Sonderprojekte im Zusammenhang mit der Entwicklung von Spa-Produkten.

Ihre Reise so weit

- Starke kommerzielle und analytische Denkweise mit nachgewiesener Erfahrung im Produktleistungsmanagement

- Ausgezeichnete Stakeholder Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

- Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung zu verwalten

- Strategisches Denken kombiniert mit Hand-on-Ausführung

- Starke Verhandlungs- und Lieferantenmanagementfähigkeiten

- Hohe Liebe zum Detail mit Fokus auf Qualität und Gasterlebnis

- Bewährte Erfahrung in Spa, Wellness, Schönheit oder Gastfreundschaft Produktmanagement

- Starkes Verständnis von Spa-Betrieben, Behandlungen und Einzelhandelsumgebungen

- Erfahrungen mit Premium- oder Luxusmarken

Ihre Essenzen

- 10-15 Jahre Erfahrung in SPA und Wellness einschließlich Medispa Behandlungen, Einzelhandelsprodukte und Wellness-Konzepte,

- Erprobte Erfahrung in der Konzeption des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus, von der Konzeptentwicklung und Lieferantenauswahl, rechtlichen Anforderungen, Start, Leistungsüberwachung und Optimierung.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten vor allem bei der Führung großer Teams und der Beeinflussung von Interessenvertretern.

- Fluency in English ist obligatorisch jede andere Sprache ist ein Plus.

- Starke Führungsfähigkeiten, um SPA-Operationen über mehrere Standorte zu überwachen.

- Erfahrung mit Projektmanagement Finanzanalyse und Umsatzmanagement in der Wellness- oder Gastfreundschaftsbranche.

- Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Abteilungen wie Marketing Guest Services und Revenue Management zu arbeiten, um ein zusammenhängendes Wellness-Erlebnis für Gäste zu schaffen.

- Schweizer Staatsangehörigkeit oder Recht auf Arbeit in der Schweiz.

Unser Engagement

Wir sind verpflichtet, eine Zukunft aufzubauen, die unterschiedliche Perspektiven wertet, die Welt jenseits der Grenzen umarmt und eine integrative Umgebung fördert, in der jeder Mensch sich wertschätzt, respektiert und befähigt fühlt, seine authentischen Selbst zu sein. Unser Engagement erstreckt sich auf sinnvolle, messbare Handlungen, die langfristig positive Auswirkungen auf unsere Gäste, unsere Mitarbeiter und unseren Planeten haben.

Bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft in etwas Außergewöhnliches zu verwandeln? Besuchen Sie uns bei MSC Cruises, wo neue Möglichkeiten erwartet werden. Wenden Sie sich heute an, Teil eines globalen Teams zu sein, das Grenzen drängt und etwas bemerkenswertes erreicht. Deine Reise beginnt hier!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Junior Architect supports the Port Development team through fast and accurate production of conceptual and technical drawings.
The role is focused on internal execution: transforming design inputs into conceptual documentation and effective visualizations to support decision-making across private destinations, cruise terminals, port infrastructure and related facilities.

Your Impact

- Support the translation of business and design inputs into zoning studies, basic spatial diagrams, and architectural layouts.

- Assist in the development of preliminary layouts following internal design guidance and operational requirements.

- Prepare early stage conceptual design packages for internal review and coordination.

- Produce presentation decks, diagrams, visual narratives, and material boards to support internal communication.

- Develop mandatory 3D models and real time visualizations to support internal reviews and executive level presentations.

- Rapidly update, correct, and revise architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, layouts, façade studies, and circulation diagrams.

- Adapt and coordinate port and civil drawings, including site layouts, infrastructure interfaces, circulation roads, and hardscape coordination.

Your Journey so far

- Strong passion for architecture and the world of interiors, materials and spatial composition.

- Curious and design-oriented, with attention to proportion, atmosphere and detail.

- Execution-driven and highly operational.

- Fast in drawing production and revisions.

- Detail-oriented and structured.

- Comfortable working under tight timelines in a dynamic development environment.

Your Essentials

- Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD with strong drafting speed and precision.

- Strong 3D modeling capabilities in SketchUp or Revit (SketchUp preferred).

- Mandatory experience with real-time rendering tools (Enscape, Twinmotion or equivalent).

- Good knowledge of Photoshop for post-production and corrections.

- Basic knowledge of (or interest in) AI tools such as Stable Diffusion or Magnific AI.

- The ability to independently produce clear, standard-quality visualizations for internal decision-making.

- Portfolio including technical drawings and rendered visualizations to be shared with the CV.

The Junior Architect Port Development Intern must be enrolled in a study program requiring a valid internship agreement. Candidates must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. Full professional proficiency in English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

Your Purpose

We are seeking a dynamic and highly motivated Mobile App Product Specialist to join our Business Innovation team at MSC Cruises Headquarters in Geneva. This role is designed for a data-driven professional with a strong commercial acumen, an analytical mindset, and a passion for optimizing mobile user journeys. The successful candidate will explore in-app behaviors, remove friction in the sales funnel, and drive product-led initiatives to maximize conversion rates and shape the future of digital guest experiences across the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

Your Impact

- Analyze the MSC for Me in-app user journey and behavior to identify bottlenecks, proposing and validating product initiatives that optimize the sales funnel and boost in-app conversion rates.

- Collaborate with Product, Tech, and UX/UI cross-functional teams to design and implement features that drive organic user acquisition and increase cross-selling/up-selling opportunities for the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Implement and optimize the in-app position of commercial offerings (working closing with Onboard Revenues Commercial Department) to maximize visibility and sales conversions specifically for mobile users.

- Use advanced product analytics tools and data visualization (Power BI) to track sales performance, user activation rates, and drop-offs into the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Act as a bridge between the Onboard Revenues Commercial department and the Tech/Development teams, translating revenue goals into clear digital product requirements to enhance the MSC for Me digital ecosystem.

- Drive MSC for Me  channel-led acquisition by refining native in-app features—such as frictionless guest-to-registered user flows, invite-a-friend mechanisms, and seamless app sharing—to grow the user base.

- Conduct A/B testing on MSC for Me  in-app sales flows, checkout processes, and subscription models to continuously improve operational efficiency and revenue generation.

Your Journey so far

- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Marketing Management, Digital or a related field.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills with 3 to 5 years of proven experience in digital sales, product growth, or digital business development, with a strict focus on mobile applications.

- Hands-on experience with app analytics, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and data manipulation/visualization tools (Power BI, SQL; Python is a plus).

- Familiarity with agile methodologies and ability to work side-by-side with developers and product managers in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate data-driven insights into actionable business and product recommendations.

- Creative thinker with a proactive approach to problem-solving, capable of driving "Product-Led Growth" rather than relying on traditional marketing spend.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Your Essentials

- Deep understanding of mobile user behavior, digital sales funnels, and product-centric acquisition ecosystems.

- Strong business acumen with a focus on maximizing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and removing friction from the mobile buying experience.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs under tight deadlines.

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only.
The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization.
For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction.
For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles.
Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations.

Your Impact

Global Learning & Development Strategy (Onboard & Ashore)

- Define and implement the global Learning & Development strategy covering both shipboard crew and shore-based employees.

- Develop an integrated learning ecosystem that supports operational excellence onboard and leadership capability ashore.

- Ensure learning initiatives directly support strategic priorities such as:

- guest experience excellence

- safety and compliance

- operational performance

- leadership effectiveness

- digital and business transformation

- Oversee onboarding and development frameworks to accelerate employee integration and performance across both shipboard and shore environments.

- Lead the adoption of modern learning approaches including digital learning, simulation-based training, microlearning, and blended learning solutions.

Shipboard Learning & Development

- Lead the design and delivery of the global shipboard learning and development strategy across the fleet.

- Partner closely with Marine Operations, Hotel Operations, Food & Beverage, and Guest Experience leadership to ensure training programs support operational priorities and service excellence.

- Ensure consistent training standards across the fleet while accommodating the operational realities of shipboard environments.

- Oversee development programs for key shipboard roles, including supervisory and management development programs for future onboard leaders.

- Support structured career development pathways for shipboard crew, enabling internal progression across hospitality and operational functions.

- Ensure alignment with all maritime regulatory training requirements and safety standards.

Shore-Based Learning & Development

- Lead the design and implementation of learning and development programs for shore-based employees across corporate and operational functions.

- Develop capability-building initiatives supporting key business priorities such as:

- commercial capabilities

- digital transformation

- operational excellence

- guest-centric culture

- Design structured leadership development programs for emerging, mid-level, and senior leaders.

- Develop functional academies and capability frameworks supporting critical corporate disciplines.

Talent Management & Succession Planning (Ashore Only)

- Define and implement the company’s global talent management strategy for shore-based employees.

- Lead processes for:

- talent identification and talent reviews

- succession planning for critical leadership roles

- high-potential development programs

- leadership pipeline development

- career development frameworks

- Partner with executive leadership and HR Business Partners to ensure strong succession pipelines for key corporate and operational leadership positions ashore.

- Embed talent management practices into performance management and leadership development frameworks.

Leadership Development

- Design and implement leadership development programs supporting both shipboard and shore-based leadership populations.

- Establish a global leadership framework aligned with the company’s values and guest-centric culture.

- Strengthen leadership capabilities in areas such as:

- people leadership

- operational decision-making

- service excellence

- innovation and continuous improvement

- cross-cultural leadership

Your Journey so far

Education

- Master’s degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or related field.

Experience

- 15+ years of progressive experience in Learning & Development, Talent Management, or Organizational Development.

- Significant experience designing and implementing global learning strategies for large, international workforces.

- Proven experience leading talent management and succession planning programs for corporate leadership populations.

- Experience in cruise, hospitality, travel, aviation, or other large service-driven organizations strongly preferred.

- Experience working in highly multicultural and geographically distributed environments.

Key Competences

- Strategic Learning & Capability Development

- Talent Management & Succession Planning (Corporate)

- Service Excellence & Hospitality Culture

- Stakeholder Influence & Executive Partnership

- Global Mindset & Cultural Intelligence

- Organizational Development

- Learning Technology & Digital Learning

Your Essentials

- Fluency in English is required; Italian, French, German or other European languages are a plus.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Vice President Global SPA and Wellness is the global business owner for all onboard SPA, wellness, beauty, and fitness operations across the Cruise Division of MSC Group, spanning MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) and Explora Journeys (Luxury).

The role has full accountability for SPA and treatment programs, fitness and thermal areas, salon services, wellness retail, medical aesthetics (where applicable), and future digital wellness offerings.

This position ensures that luxury wellness standards, service rituals, therapeutic excellence, and holistic wellbeing philosophies are fully embedded—particularly for Explora Journeys—while maintaining scalable, brand-differentiated wellness frameworks across the fleet.

The VP defines the long-term global SPA and wellness vision, drives commercial performance, elevates guest satisfaction, and evolves wellness concepts that differentiate MSC Group’s Cruise Division across contemporary, premium, and luxury segments.

Your Impact

Strategic & Commercial Leadership

- Define and lead the global SPA and wellness strategy across contemporary, premium, and luxury brands, aligned with differentiated guest profiles and brand positioning.

- Act as business owner for Global SPA and Wellness, with explicit accountability for luxury wellness concepts and standards.

- Own the end-to-end commercial roadmap, including treatment architecture, pricing strategy, promotions, capacity optimisation, and end-to-end guest journey design.

- Lead strategic negotiations with SPA operators, wellness partners, medical aesthetics providers (where permitted), product brands, and equipment suppliers.

- Drive growth in high-margin and premium wellness categories, including signature treatments, medical aesthetics, fitness and longevity programs, wellness retail, and personalised wellbeing journeys.

- Develop scalable yet brand-distinct SPA and wellness frameworks, enabling selective deployment of premium and luxury concepts across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

Operational and Brand Excellence

- Oversee SPA operations fleet-wide, ensuring consistent service delivery, treatment quality, hygiene standards, and guest satisfaction.

- Define service standards, therapist certification requirements, training programs, and performance benchmarks across all SPA formats.

- Ensure luxury wellness excellence for Explora Journeys, including service rituals, therapist conduct, holistic programming, privacy standards, and immersive wellness environments.

- Introduce tier-specific wellness concepts, signature and luxury rituals, experiential programming, and destination-inspired treatments.

- Ensure fleet readiness for newbuilds and dry docks, including SPA layout design, equipment selection, CAPEX planning, and concept activation.

Financial Management

- Own the full P&L for SPA and Wellness across all Cruise Division brands, including annual budgets, revenue targets, margin improvement, and cost control.

- Optimise therapist productivity, treatment mix, pricing discipline, retail attachment rates, staffing models, and concession economics.

- Leverage advanced analytics to drive demand forecasting, yield management, guest segmentation, booking optimisation, and treatment performance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance, and Newbuild teams to integrate wellness into the overall guest experience.

- Collaborate with CRM and Digital teams on pre-cruise wellness engagement, onboard booking optimisation, and personalised wellness journeys.

- Align SPA offerings with itinerary, destination, and onboard programming to maximise relevance differentiation, and revenue.

Leadership & Organisational Development

- Lead a global HQ and fleet SPA and wellness organisation, including strategy, operations, training, and partner management teams.

- Build a culture of guest-centric service excellence, luxury wellness stewardship, commercial discipline, and continuous innovation.

- Mentor senior leaders and strengthen capabilities across SPA operations, luxury wellness concept development, and data-driven performance management.

Your Journey so far

- 15+ years senior leadership experience in SPA, wellness, hospitality, cruise, or multi-site service businesses.

- Proven success owning complex P&Ls and driving profitability in service-led environments.

- Deep expertise in SPA operations, wellness programming, service quality management, and luxury guest experience standards.

- Strong experience managing third-party operators, concession models, or global vendor partnerships.

Your Essentials

- Excellent leadership, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

- Willingness to travel extensively and operate in a fast-paced international environment.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Vice President Global SPA and Wellness è il proprietario di business globale per tutte le operazioni di SPA, benessere, bellezza e fitness a bordo della Divisione Crociera di MSC Group, che comprende MSC Cruises (Contemporary & Premium) e Explora Journeys (Luxury). Il ruolo ha piena responsabilità per i programmi SPA e di trattamento, aree fitness e termali, servizi di salone, vendita al dettaglio benessere, estetica medica (dove applicabile), e future offerte di benessere digitale. Questa posizione garantisce che gli standard di lusso per il benessere, i rituali di servizio, l'eccellenza terapeutica e le filosofie olistiche per il benessere siano completamente incorporati, in particolare per Explora Journeys, pur mantenendo ambienti benessere scalabili e differenziati dal marchio in tutta la flotta. Il VP definisce la visione globale di SPA e benessere a lungo termine, spinge le prestazioni commerciali, eleva la soddisfazione degli ospiti, ed evolve concetti di benessere che differenziano la Divisione Crociera di MSC Group attraverso segmenti contemporanei, premium e di lusso. Il tuo impatto Leadership strategica e commerciale - Definire e guidare la strategia globale di SPA e benessere attraverso marchi contemporanei, premium e di lusso, allineati con profili ospiti differenziati e posizionamento del marchio. - Agire come proprietario di business per Global SPA e Wellness, con responsabilità esplicita per i concetti e gli standard di lusso. - Proprio la roadmap commerciale end-to-end, tra cui l'architettura del trattamento, la strategia dei prezzi, le promozioni, l'ottimizzazione della capacità e la progettazione del viaggio degli ospiti end-to-end. - Condurre trattative strategiche con gli operatori SPA, partner benessere, fornitori di estetica medica (dove consentito), marchi di prodotto e fornitori di attrezzature. - Crescita dell'azionamento in categorie di benessere ad alto livello e premium, tra cui trattamenti firma, estetica medica, programmi di fitness e longevità, vendita al dettaglio di benessere e viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Sviluppare framework SPA e wellness scalabili ma distinguibili, consentendo la distribuzione selettiva di concetti premium e di lusso attraverso MSC Cruises e Explora Journeys. Eccellenza operativa e di marca - Superare le operazioni SPA a livello di flotta, assicurando la fornitura di servizi coerenti, la qualità del trattamento, gli standard igienici e la soddisfazione degli ospiti. - Definire standard di servizio, requisiti di certificazione terapeutica, programmi di formazione e benchmark di prestazioni in tutti i formati SPA. - Assicurare l'eccellenza del benessere di lusso per i viaggi Explora, inclusi rituali di servizio, condotta terapeutica, programmazione olistica, norme sulla privacy e ambienti benessere immersivi. - Introdurre concetti di benessere specifici, rituali di firma e lusso, programmazione esperienziale e trattamenti ispirati alla destinazione. - Assicurare la disponibilità della flotta per nuove costruzioni e banchine a secco, tra cui progettazione di layout SPA, selezione di attrezzature, pianificazione CAPEX e attivazione del concetto. Gestione finanziaria - Possedere la P&L completa per SPA e Wellness in tutti i marchi della Divisione Crociera, inclusi budget annui, target di ricavi, miglioramento dei margini e controllo dei costi. - Ottimizzare la produttività del terapeuta, il mix di trattamento, la disciplina dei prezzi, i tassi di attaccamento al dettaglio, i modelli di personale e l'economia di concessione. - Leva analisi avanzate per guidare la previsione della domanda, la gestione dei rendimenti, la segmentazione degli ospiti, l'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni e le prestazioni del trattamento. Collaborazione trasversale - Partner a stretto contatto con i team Hotel Operations, Medical, Fitness, Retail, F&B, Shorex, Digital, Finance e Newbuild per integrare il benessere nell'esperienza complessiva degli ospiti. - Collabora con i team CRM e Digital nell'impegno pre-cruise wellness, nell'ottimizzazione delle prenotazioni a bordo e nei viaggi di benessere personalizzati. - Allineare le offerte SPA con itinerario, destinazione e programmazione a bordo per massimizzare la differenziazione di rilevanza e le entrate. Leadership & Sviluppo organizzativo - Guidare un QQ globale e la flotta SPA e l'organizzazione benessere, tra cui team di strategia, operazioni, formazione e gestione dei partner. - Costruisci una cultura dell'eccellenza del servizio guest-centric, della gestione del benessere di lusso, della disciplina commerciale e dell'innovazione continua. - Mentor senior leader e rafforzare le capacità tra le operazioni SPA, lo sviluppo del concetto di benessere di lusso e la gestione delle prestazioni guidata dai dati. Il tuo viaggio finora - 15+ anni di esperienza di leadership senior in SPA, benessere, ospitalità, crociera, o multi-sito servizi business. - Proven successo proprietario di P&L complessi e la redditività di guida in ambienti orientati al servizio. - Profonda competenza nelle operazioni SPA, programmazione del benessere, gestione della qualità dei servizi e standard di esperienza degli ospiti di lusso. - Forte esperienza nella gestione di operatori di terze parti, modelli di concessione, o partnership di fornitori globali. I tuoi essenziali - Eccellente leadership, negoziazione e competenze di gestione degli stakeholder interfunzionali. - Volontà di viaggiare e operare in un ambiente internazionale veloce. Il nostro impegno Ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro che valorizza diverse prospettive, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valorizzato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il proprio sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!

Excellence opérationnelle et d'image de marque - Surveiller les opérations de SPA dans toute la flotte, en assurant une prestation de services cohérente, la qualité du traitement, les normes d'hygiène et la satisfaction des clients. - Définir les normes de service, les exigences de certification des thérapeutes, les programmes de formation et les repères de rendement pour tous les formats de SPA. - Assurer l'excellence en bien-être de luxe pour Explora Journeys, y compris les rituels de service, la conduite des thérapeutes, la programmation holistique, les normes de confidentialité et les environnements de bien-être immersifs. - Introduire des concepts de bien-être spécifiques, des rituels de signature et de luxe, une programmation expérientielle et des traitements inspirés de la destination. - Assurer l'état de préparation de la flotte pour les nouvelles constructions et les cales sèches, y compris la conception de l'aménagement du SPA, la sélection de l'équipement, la planification du CAPEX et l'activation du concept. Vos essentiels - Excellent leadership, négociation et compétences de gestion interfonctionnelles des intervenants. - Volonté de voyager largement et d'opérer dans un environnement international rapide. Notre engagement s'étend à prendre des mesures significatives et mesurables qui ont un impact positif à long terme sur nos invités, nos employés et notre planète. Prêt à transformer votre passion en quelque chose d'extraordinaire ? Rejoignez-nous au MSC Cruises, où de nouvelles opportunités attendent. Appliquer aujourd'hui pour faire partie d'une équipe mondiale qui repousse les frontières et réalise quelque chose de remarquable. Votre voyage commence ici !

jobs.title: Culinary Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Your Purpose

The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B.

Your Impact

Strategic Culinary Leadership

- Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy.

- Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices.

- Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs.

- Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects.

Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance

- Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required.

- Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels.

- Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements.

- Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols.

- Oversee beverage order and loading coordination.

Training & Leadership Development

- Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs.

- Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards.

- Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions.

Human Resources & Team Management

- Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness.

- Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing.

- Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations.

Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination

- Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet.

- Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards.

- Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership.

Financial Oversight

- Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management.

- Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department.

- Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets.

- Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning.

- Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department.

Your Journey so far

- Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills.

- At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations.

- Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management.

Your Essentials

Leadership & Communication

- Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams.

- Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset.

Technical & Operational Knowledge

- Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems.

- Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations.

- Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards.

Professional Competencies

- Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen.

- Highly detail-oriented, results-driven, and guest experience-focused.

- Strong collaborator capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams.

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!
